label: Simple priority is well-founded, from grounding well-founded on actual concreta
description: Non-transcription conditional derivation on one m and w, for the shared frame's simple-priority field F.PriorSimply (SIMPLY_PRIOR_1). If grounding among actual concreta at w is well-founded (82cfaf26), whatever is simply prior to something other than itself is an actual concrete ground of it at w (86efed1a) and nothing is prior to itself (32d77f18), then simple priority is well-founded on the whole carrier (d85de8e1). Step: what is prior to x is other than x by irreflexivity, hence an actual concretum grounding x; well-foundedness transfers. The priority well-foundedness premise thus becomes a consequence of the grounding one, but only on the reading of PriorSimply on which 86efed1a is plausible, priority in being (what x depends on for its being). On that reading, the existing chain from d85de8e1 to the secunda via premise 97f5850f (e229bb2c, 438866fa) still needs the all-respects premise e078f07b (every efficient cause in any respect is simply prior), against which lane B keeps the hand/stick counterexample (causal-dependence-support-investigation.md, row 1); so this argument does not by itself carry well-founded grounding to the secunda via. The closed controls priorityControls give, for each input, a Bool interpretation in which the other two hold and priority is not well-founded (the irreflexivity omission is a self-loop, which the distinct-relata bridge does not see), and a nonvacuous interpretation.
